claims.violated_requirement: Gray-to-binary conversion should use XOR operations between adjacent bits. Replacing XOR with OR in the second conversion step causes incorrect binary values, leading to wrong Gray code outputs after increment and conversion.
claims.spec_basis: The implementation should follow this process: 1. Input a Gray code value, 2. Convert the Gray code to binary representation using XOR operations

claims.violated_requirement: Final Gray-to-binary conversion step should use XOR but uses AND instead, causing incorrect least significant bit in binary representation which propagates to wrong Gray code output.
claims.spec_basis: Gray code conversion to binary should use XOR operations between adjacent bits

claims.violated_requirement: Most significant bit of binary representation should directly copy from Gray code input but is forced to zero, causing all subsequent XOR conversions to be incorrect.
claims.spec_basis: Conversion process should preserve MSB from Gray code input

candidates.grammar_error: Syntax-token insertion/deletion is forbidden. Replace at most two existing operands/operators, or swap one existing two-operand concatenation. Do not append an if guard.

claims.violated_requirement: Binary-to-Gray conversion should use XOR between value and right-shifted version but uses AND instead, breaking Gray code property of single-bit changes between values.
claims.spec_basis: Binary to gray code conversion should use XOR between value and its right-shifted version
